Pixel Agents office engine and bundled assets
=============================================

This vendored subsystem is adapted from Pixel Agents 1.4.1 at commit
3537e140c2094761beae748592aeb92ece8edfdd:
https://github.com/pixel-agents-hq/pixel-agents

Pixel Agents is Copyright (c) 2026 Pablo De Lucca and licensed under the MIT
License. A verbatim copy of that license is served with the bundled assets at
static/vendor/pixel-agents/LICENSE.

The bundled character artwork is based on JIK-A-4's MetroCity Free Top Down
Character Pack, published as CC0 1.0:
https://jik-a-4.itch.io/metrocity-free-topdown-character-pack

Restless keeps the engine behind a brand-neutral projection adapter. Pixel
Agents remains the upstream implementation and is not a source of Work truth.

Restless no longer ships the furniture, floor, wall or carpet artwork that came with the
pack. Those assets are generated by web/scripts/generate-office-art.mjs and are original Restless
work. The engine code and the pet sheets remain Pixel Agents under the licence above.
